metadata.agent_last_message:
All five subcommands work, fixed-point holds, output files are proper sizes. The implementation is complete.

Summary of what was built in `/workspace/output/`:

- **main.js** — CLI dispatcher with five subcommands (parse, write, query, eval, roundtrip), proper exit codes (0/1/2), and JSON-formatted error envelopes per §1.4
- **core.js** — Common utilities: Hollerith parsing helpers, real/integer/logical type coercion, status code encode/decode, timestamp parsing/formatting, units/spec_version/drafting_std code↔name mappings
- **parser.js** — IGES file parser: section detection (S/G/D/P/T), 80-col line splitting, Global section delimiter detection (Forms 1-4), free-format tokenizer with Hollerith-aware delimiter handling, Directory Entry parsing, Parameter Data record assembly (handles multi-line records via DE back-pointer keying), per-entity PD dispatch, cross-reference validation
- **entities.js** — Per-entity PD parsers and writers for all 87 IGES 5.3 entity types covered by the catalog, with proper FieldStream/FieldList abstractions and form-dependent handling for Types 190/192/194/196/198/218/222/304/322/404/410/416
- **writer.js** — IGES file writer: 80-col fixed-format output, DE pointer remapping based on entity array order, parameter data wrapping at 64 cols, validation of degenerate Lines (start == terminate) and Global numerics
- **eval.js** — Parametric evaluation: Cox-de Boor B-spline basis, all curve evaluators (100, 102, 104, 106, 110, 112, 126, 130) and surface evaluators (114, 118, 120, 122, 128, 140, 190, 192, 194, 196, 198) with xform_matrix application
